headline: Clean: from the on-file open date (65 days of tenure) Hunter Green ($175) is the best referral the customer qualifies for, and World Blue's 90-day tenure rule correctly blocks the account she owns.
solution_check: Earliest checking is World Blue, opened 09/10/2025, which gives 65 days of tenure (doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047: 'calculated from ... the date your earliest checking account was opened'). Programs within 65 days and $31,000: Hunter Green $175 (60 days, $10k), Cobalt Blue $150 (60 days), Sky Blue $150 (45 days, new LLC), Navy Blue $100. Lime Green, World Blue and True Blue need 90 days, Beige needs 120. That matches gold[3], and the gold replays cleanly.
prior_note: The data is unchanged since the prior review. I reclassify its Minor (customer vague about tenure) as an intended DB-verification trap: the gold's required accounts read shows the 09/10/2025 date, so it is a note rather than a validity defect.
